race.description: Pcr Building Services Pty Ltd Mdn Plate
race.comment: SHES XEE (10) started favourite at the last run before a break but could only manage second at Braidwood. Fitted with a Goulburn trial and can make a bold return. BELLA KATELYN (5) was close to a maiden win before a nine weeks break, finishing off with a placing over 1000m at this track. Expect she has come on over the break. Bold showing expected. BYGO LASS (11) is on debut for the Gary Colvin stable. Three-year-old filly by Pierata has just had the one hit-out at Gundagai in readiness and should acquit herself well. Watch for a positive market lead. ALOTOFSOJU (4) went forward last time but couldn't quicken in the run home and finished seventh over 1100m at Goulburn. Finds a suitable assignment this time and can improve. EIGHTEEN MONTHS (1) is mixing his form but boast figures that can be competitive.
